all.source_quote: Eligible elderly individuals aged 65 and above
whose names are on the Below Poverty Line (BPL) list

ambiguous: This state page says 65 and above; the national NSAP rule has been 60 and above since 2011 (not on this page)

en.title: Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension Scheme
en.benefit: Rs 200 per month (65 to 79) or Rs 500 (80+) from the Centre, plus a state top-up under the Shravanbal scheme in Maharashtra.
en.how_to_apply: Apply at the Collector's office, Tehsildar's office (Sanjay Gandhi Niradhar Anudan Yojana branch) or Talathi office.
